ai_summary: DSJ Keep Learning Limited issued a corrigendum to its FY2025-26 Annual Report, disclosing a material understatement of related-party revenue by INR 104.2 lakhs (approximately 16-22% of previously stated totals). This significant financial correction, along with a revised AGM cut-off date, raises concerns about the accuracy of initial financial reporting and the robustness of internal controls. The substantial revision to sensitive related-party transactions is a notable red flag, warranting further investor scrutiny.
